_about: Evidence for the indexing statuses that a script cannot establish. WEBSITE_DEPLOYED, FULLTEXT_AVAILABLE and SCHOLAR_METADATA_VALID are measured live by scripts/indexing_report.py. The fields below are observations made by a person or a one-off read, each with the date and method. 'unknown' means not observed; it never means 'no'. Update an entry only after observing it, and write the date and method. Do not script Google Scholar searches: Scholar answers automated requests with a bot challenge.

profile.method: single unauthenticated GET of the public profile page
